system.description:
Prerequisites: Intermediate Celerity, Elder Fortitude (Personal Armor). Named for the legendary brother with iron bones, this Discipline hardens one chosen appendage (head and neck count as one) along with the body's recuperative properties, preventing it from being severed or punctured. The user spends a Willpower Trait to activate; the next blow that would sever the chosen appendage is entirely ignored, with no damage or penalty, and it can be reactivated at the start of the next turn to keep protecting the same appendage as long as Willpower Traits remain. A lesser-known application hardens the tissue around the heart, preventing staking until the user's Willpower runs out. Lasts one scene or until a sufficiently powerful blow lands, whichever comes first; if the scene ends first, the power fizzles harmlessly and may be reactivated later.

Costs 12 Experience Traits to learn.
system.duration: One scene or until a decisive blow lands
